title.narrative: Building Partnerships for the Sustainable Development Goals - Empowering Disabled People's Organisations

description.narrative: This action aims to give women, men and children with disabilities through disabled peoples organisations a voice in sustainable development planning, implementation and monitoring at local, state, national, regional, national and international levels. This will enable DPOs to articulate their needs, priorities, and demand their rights in line with the EU and the Government of Indias commitment to safeguarding fundamental rights while achieving prosperity and development.
